about_the_game:
2KXX is a local multiplayer game. Fight your friends on a selection of various characters, maps, and game modes. Spice your Match with a list of modifiers that can make your life easier or worse.

Local multiplayer action

2KXX only allows local multiplayer gameplay (or via remote play together). Hop on matches with 2 to 4 players. Play alone or in teams in a shared or split screen and fight for the victory.

Endless match possibilities

With more than 25 playable characters, 14 maps, and game modes, every match won't be the same.

A modifiers system to spice up gameplay

With a list of 18 unique modifiers that can totally change the way you play your match, you will be able to make your life easier or worse by activating them or not. For example, you can get unlimited sprint or munitions, force the players to die in a single hit, or make them explode when they die. There are many possibilities.

Cute and colorful pixel graphics

2KXX has been made with cute and colorful pixel graphics in a full top view; characters animations are organic.

Unlockable content

While you play matches, you will unlock new playable characters. There is also an unlockable secret map. Will you be able to unlock everything?
